WHERE YOU'LL BE
Mustang Island, Port Aransas
"Talk to the Sand" sits in the Sunrise Beach community on Mustang Island — just south of Cinnamon Shore, one of Port Aransas's most sought-after coastal neighborhoods. The beach is steps away via the community boardwalk, and the golf cart gets you anywhere on the island in minutes.

🏖 On the Beach 🏊 Community Pool 🛺 Golf Cart Included 🐾 Pet-Friendly 🍳 Full Kitchen 👕 Washer & Dryer 🌿 Balcony / Patio 🔥 Charcoal Grill 📶 Free WiFi ❄️ Air Conditioning 🚫 Non-Smoking

"Talk to the Sand" is a whole beachfront home in the gated Sunrise Beach community, where a private boardwalk puts your feet in the Gulf in minutes. The open-concept main level connects a fully stocked kitchen — quartz counters, stainless appliances, turquoise tile backsplash — through a dining nook that seats nine, and into a comfortable living room with a sectional that converts to a queen sleeper. Two king suites feature warm wood shiplap accent walls, and a third room with twin beds is ideal for the younger guests. A charcoal grill and outdoor dining table round out the back patio, and the six-passenger golf cart is yours for the week.

A Note From Your Agent

This home sits in the Cinnamon Shore area of Mustang Island — one of the most desirable pockets in Port Aransas. The golf cart is the real differentiator here: it makes the whole island accessible and takes parking off the table entirely. Confirm pet policy and any pet fees at booking if bringing animals. VRBO rates for July peak dates can shift — the nightly figure above reflects what was displayed at time of research and should be verified before finalizing.

Next: Explore Port Aransas
EXPLORE PORT ARANSAS
Dining & Activities
Here are some of our favorite spots to eat and things to do while you're on the island. Tap any that interest you — we'll factor them into your planning.
DINING & DRINKS
Virginia's on the Bay
Waterfront Texas seafood with Gulf views and a full bar · ~$25–45/pp
Pelican's Landing
Laid-back waterfront spot — shrimp baskets, cold drinks, live music on weekends · ~$15–25/pp
Shell's Pasta & Seafood
Local favorite for fresh pasta and Gulf seafood — great for a relaxed group dinner · ~$20–35/pp
ACTIVITIES & EXPERIENCES
Dolphin & Wildlife Boat Tour
Guided 90-min cruise through the bay with near-guaranteed dolphin sightings · ~$35–55/pp
Deep Sea Fishing Charter
Half-day offshore charters with equipment included — great for all skill levels · ~$75–125/pp
Mustang Island State Park
5 miles of undeveloped Gulf beach — birding, kayaking, nature trails · $5/person day use
Horace Caldwell Pier
Iconic Port A pier for fishing or a sunset walk over the Gulf · $1–5/person
